review_candidates.description_excerpt: You'll work directly with customers from technical discovery and solution design through implementation, migration, and handoff, helping them choose and deploy solutions that fit their technical requirements, budgets, and long-term goals. Variety of environments - Work across different customers, technologies, and infrastructure challenges instead of maintaining the same internal environment every day. eligibility_evidence: Our work spans servers, storage, virtualization, backup and disaster recovery, networking, Microsoft 365, and hybrid infrastructure.
Broad technology exposure - Work across servers, storage, virtualization, backup/DR, networking, Microsoft 365, and hybrid infrastructure rather than being siloed into one technology.
Experience with hybrid cloud environments, Microsoft 365 Education, Google Workspace for Education, and identity integrations.

review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: You'll work directly with customers from technical discovery and solution design through implementation, migration, and handoff, helping them choose and deploy solutions that fit their technical requirements, budgets, and long-term goals. This customer-facing role combines hands-on engineering, technical consulting, and project delivery across server, virtualization, storage, backup, and network environments. Key Responsibilities Solution Design & Technical Consulting Assess customer infrastructure, identify gaps, and recommend solutions that fit technical requirements, staffing, and budgets. Support infrastructure requirements for learning platforms, student information systems, research, and administrative applications. Incorporate customer requirements for student data privacy, web filtering, secure access, and network segmentation. Required Qualifications At least 7 years of progress
